immediate_outcome: The live workspace has a Source page that reads local Git, Jujutsu and Pijul repositories: bounded revision logs, directory trees and exact file content.
durable_capability: Typed separate source policy plus bounded read-only source observation reused by the workspace.

maintenance_owner.application: Kiln web-service maintainers own the reader, bounds and view.
maintenance_owner.operation: Local operator owns repository and executable selection, the --sources policy and activation.

browser: Three sources listed with kind, head and revision scope; unavailable states are distinguished from empty ones.
Selecting a repository navigates and loads revisions; a revision pins tree and file reads by URL.
Directory navigation shows a breadcrumb and exact entry kinds with byte sizes.
README.md rendered 27,939 bytes at revision 278a24af… with object id and scope facts; Pijul shell.nix rendered its 715-byte working-copy content.
Reloading a selected source, revision and file URL restored that exact selection.

read_only_check.note: Reads perform no fetch, checkout, ref write, signing or publication; Git/Jujutsu reads open the object store read-only and Pijul runs log/list only.

verification.nickel: web-sources typecheck and positive export pass; three negative fixtures rejected

non_claims: Source views are bounded local reads, not a checkout, build, verification or provenance claim.
Jujutsu is read through its Git object store; Jujutsu-only metadata is not interpreted.
Pijul history is listed but not traversed, and Pijul file content is the tracked working copy, labelled as such.

live.older_step: older → moved the URL from beea6845 to 278a24af and reloaded the tree, file and diff for that revision

diff_and_navigation.truncation_semantics: Hitting the 262,144-byte cap stops the print and reports truncated=true with a 200 response; before the fix that partial stop was misreported as source_unavailable (503).

rendering.diff: per-line add/del/hunk/file/meta classes with counts and a bounded-preview note

navigation.filter: client-side entry filter carried in the URL as sq (Cargo → Cargo.lock, Cargo.toml)
navigation.up_level: breadcrumb and explicit Up one level control
navigation.steps: newer/older buttons over the loaded revision page
